features: 16 hybrid/Flex-Channel channels and up to 48 IP channels
Flex-Channel licenses usable as analog, HD analog or IP camera licenses
Analog: BNC inputs (1.0Vp-p, 75 ohm), 4CIF (704 x 480) at 30 FPS per channel, H.264 / MPEG-4 part 10
Up to 54TB storage, hot-swappable removable bays
Supported video codecs: MJPEG, MPEG-4, H.264, H.264+, H.265
Recording modes: motion, alarm, audio, analytics; audio OggVorbis 16 Kbps
Third-party integrations: access control, alarm, ATM, POS, time/attendance
notes: Spec sheet lists HD analog (HD-TVI, HD-CVI, HD-AHD) support for the -HD model only.
Spec sheet gives 2TB to 12TB per bay and up to 54TB across 3 bays; per-bay maximum left out.
Spec sheet gives analog audio inputs as "Equal to analog video inputs" and also "2U - 8CH, 3U - 16CH"; audio input count left out.
Spec sheet prints the HDMI maximum resolution as 1096x2160@60Hz.
Spec sheet key features list Microsoft Windows Embedded 10 Standard; its specifications table lists Windows 10 Enterprise LTSC 2019.
Spec sheet lists USB as "1 Front USB 2.0; 6 Rear - 4x USB3.0"; total USB port count left out.
